1

The petitioner seeks a direction to the respondents to provide adequate Police protection to the petitioner by considering the petitioner's representation, dated 15.09.2025.
2.

It is seen from the petitioner's representation that the petitioner had sought for a direction and had requested the respondents to arrest the accused and detain them under the preventive detention laws and also transfer the investigation to CBCID.

3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor, on instructions, would submit that on the complaint given by the petitioner, a case was registered in Crime No.22 of 2025 for the offence Sections 120B,
420, 423, 463 and 464 of IPC @ 120B, 419, 420, 423, 463 and 464 of IPC as against five persons and the same is under investigation.
If any other complaint is lodged by the petitioner disclosing cognizable offence, the respondents would act in accordance with law.
4. The representation of the petitioner to arrest all the accused and detain them under Goondas Act cannot be considered.
It is needless to say that it is the discretion of the respondents whether not to arrest any accused.
There cannot https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
( Uploaded on: 24/11/2025 09:12:28 pm ) Crl.O.P.(MD)No.17024 of 2025 be any request or direction by the complainant to the respondents to act in a particular manner.

Further, the request made by the petitioner, who himself is a Lawyer, to detain the accused under the preventive detention laws, has been made without understanding the purpose and object of the preventive detention law.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to entertain the request of the petitioner.

However, it is needless to say, if the petitioner makes any complaint disclosing any cognizable offence, the respondents may act in accordance with law.
5.
With the above observation, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed.
